entities.summary: Warren Lee Davis is an American former basketball player in the American Basketball Association (ABA). He played for the Anaheim Amigos (1967–68), Los Angeles Stars (1968–70), Pittsburgh Pipers (1970), The Floridians (1970–71), Carolina Cougars (1971–72) and Memphis Pros/Memphis Tams (1972–73). A forward, he was drafted in 1965 by the NBA's New York Knicks in the sixth round.
